before.alt: Rectangular contour map: a hill at left with nested loops (500, 550 labelled) and village P near the summit; village R above and right of it in the outer low ground (425/450 contours at top-left); a second hill at upper right with a 550 loop and village Q just outside it near the top-right corner; village T below it on a 500 contour; village S inside a small low closed contour (450) at the bottom.

after.alt: Rectangular contour map (25 m interval). Top-left: contours 425 and 450 run from the left edge to the top edge, with an unlabelled 475 line below them. Left hill: closed loops 500 (labelled at bottom), 525, 550 (labelled) and an innermost loop containing village P at the summit. Village R lies above the left hill, between the 475 line and the 500 loop. Right side: a 500 contour (labelled) and a 525 contour run from the top edge down to the right edge; inside them a hill with a 550 loop (labelled) and an inner loop; village Q is near the top-right corner between the 525 line and the 550 loop; village T is near the right edge between the 500 and 525 lines. Bottom middle: a small closed depression with an inner 450 contour, village S inside it.
